nave.name: Landing ship
nave.desc: Your starting home. It holds base storage.
nave.why: You already have it. It does not spend power.

generador.name: Oxygen generator
generador.desc: Splits water into oxygen with power.
generador.why: Makes air to breathe. Needs water and power.

reciclador.name: Water recycler
reciclador.desc: Returns part of the water the crew used.
reciclador.why: Recovers used water so less is lost.

extractor.name: Ice extractor
extractor.why: New water from ice. Place only on ice.

refugio.name: Radiation shelter
refugio.desc: Shields the crew during solar storms.

deposito.name: Supply depot
deposito.desc: Expands storage for oxygen, water, food, and materials.
deposito.why: More space for reserves helps the base last through a disruption.

comunicaciones.name: Communications antenna
comunicaciones.desc: Maintains the link and extends the forecast when powered.
comunicaciones.why: Earlier warnings give the crew time to prepare.

laboratorio.name: Laboratory
laboratorio.desc: Studies the ground for clues while it has power.
laboratorio.why: Readings from beneath the surface help locate a buried signal.

habitat.name: Habitat
habitat.desc: Provides two shelter places and a closer logistics point.
habitat.why: A second base of operations helps the crew work farther from the ship.

tormenta-solar.name: Solar storm
tormenta-solar.desc: Fast particles from the Sun reach your base.
tormenta-solar.today: Solar storm today: choose shelter or work

tormenta-polvo.name: Dust storm
tormenta-polvo.desc: Dust in the air reduces the sunlight reaching the panels.
tormenta-polvo.today: Dust storm today. The panels generate less power.

averia.name: Equipment failure
averia.desc: A damaged building stays offline until repaired.
averia.today: Check the damaged building and repair it.

power.title: Energy and batteries
power.body: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity. In the shade they make less. Batteries store what is left over for later.

waterLoop.title: Water that returns
waterLoop.body: In space, water is recycled. On the Space Station nearly 90% comes back. Your base recovers 75%: that number is a game value.
waterLoop.realLife: The Space Station's life support system has shown that it can recover about 98% of the water the crew brings, which is the goal for long journeys.

airFromWater.title: Air from water
airFromWater.body: Water holds oxygen. With electricity you can split it. That process is electrolysis. The Space Station makes oxygen this way.
airFromWater.realLife: On the Space Station, the Oxygen Generation System breaks water apart with electricity (electrolysis). It makes oxygen for the crew and hydrogen as a by-product.

growFood.title: Food that grows
growFood.body: Plants need water, light, and time. If one day they miss something, the harvest comes later and is smaller.

firstAir.title: Air first
firstAir.body: Without air you last a short time. Without water a bit longer. Without food longer still. The game checks needs in that order.

solarStorm.title: Solar storm
solarStorm.body: Sometimes the Sun throws fast particles. NASA records those events. The one you see here was real. Base radiation numbers are game values.
solarStorm.realLife: The storm in this game is based on a real event: a solar particle storm that NASA's DONKI database recorded on 10 September 2017.

moonIce.title: Lunar ice
moonIce.body: In this mission, ice sits in a crater floor. Your extractor turns it into water for the base. This map detail is story for the game.

signalDelay.title: Signals that take time
signalDelay.body: Radio signals travel at light speed. They still take time: about a second to the Moon, and minutes to Mars.

sol.title: A day on Mars
sol.body: A Martian solar day is called a sol. It lasts about 24 hours and 40 minutes. In this mission, a sol is one turn.
sol.realLife: A Mars solar day, or sol, lasts on average 24 hours 39 minutes 35 seconds, about 3% longer than a day on Earth.

marsDust.title: Power in a dust storm
marsDust.body: During a regional storm, InSight’s solar energy fell from 425 to 275 watt-hours per sol. The game models that drop by setting panel output to 65% during a regional storm.
marsDust.realLife: In 2022, a dust storm on Mars cut the energy of NASA's InSight lander from 425 to 275 watt-hours per sol. Its panels were already covered in dust.

sameStormMars.title: A solar storm reaches Mars
sameStormMars.body: During the September 2017 solar storm, Curiosity measured more than twice its previous record radiation level on the Martian surface. The mission uses its own exposure scale.
sameStormMars.realLife: The September 2017 solar storm more than doubled the highest radiation that NASA's Curiosity rover had measured on the surface of Mars since it landed in 2012.

tutorial.reserves: Press R to show or hide your reserves. From top to bottom, the icons show oxygen, water, food, power, and materials. The numbers tell you how much is left.
tutorial.t01: This is your base. Above you see energy, life support, and protection.
tutorial.t02: Without power nothing works. Face an open tile and press Q to install a solar panel.
tutorial.t03: There is a mineral deposit near the ship. Face it and press E to collect it.
tutorial.t04: Sensors detect ice to the southeast. Face the terrain in shadow and press E to survey it.
tutorial.t05: Press End day to see what happened.
tutorial.t06: Place an extractor on ice and a recycler. That gives you water.
tutorial.t07: The generator makes oxygen from water. The greenhouse grows food every 4 days.
tutorial.t08: Low light is coming. A battery stores energy for that day.
tutorial.t09: Solar storm ahead. The shelter takes 2 days: build it today.
tutorial.t10: You decide. Each option has a cost.
tutorial.t11: Stable day. Keep the streak to finish the mission.
tutorial.t04random: Sensors detect ice somewhere near the base. Explore the terrain in shadow with E to find it.

learning.question: What should a crew do when a solar storm arrives?
learning.optionA: Keep working outside to save time
learning.optionB: Take shelter even if it costs energy and a work day
learning.optionC: Turn off all solar panels forever

goalDesc.soporte: Operate the ice extractor, water recycler, and oxygen generator on the same day.
goalDesc.energia: Keep stored power at or above the threshold and generate enough power for all active modules.
goalDesc.alimentos: Complete at least one harvest and keep the greenhouse running.
goalDesc.reservas: Keep oxygen, water, and food at or above the reserve threshold.
goalDesc.proteccion: Have an operational shelter with room for the crew and survive the solar storm.
goalDesc.racha: Maintain consecutive stable days without shortages or unshielded storms.
goalDesc.comunicaciones: Keep the communications antenna powered for the required consecutive sols.
goalDesc.autonomia: Sustain full life support, food, and reserves on Mars.

look.supportShip: Support ship. It brought the two extra crew members who came to help. You cannot build here.

tip.build: Mission control: low {res} reserve. Build the {building}: {why}
tip.fix: Mission control: the {building} is not working. Switch it on in the Base panel (B) or face it and press E to repair it.
tip.power: Mission control: life support is out of power. Add a solar panel or a battery before ending the day.

why.generador: it turns water into breathable oxygen.
why.extractor: place it on ice to get water.
why.reciclador: it recovers the water the crew has used.
why.invernadero: it grows food while it has power.

error.staleSeason: That season is no longer active.

report.reciclaje: Recycling saved water and avoided emissions.
report.recyclingBoost: Recycling made water efficiency more effective.
report.lowWater: Water scarcity cut the gains from restoration in half.
report.drift: Water availability and ecosystem health decline without upkeep.

victory.principle: The practices that kept the base alive also helped Earth recover.
victory.suggestion: Keep clean energy, efficient water use, recycling, and restoration working together.

deadline.principle: The season ended before every indicator reached its target.
deadline.suggestion: Invest early in several lines so their gains can build each season.

water.principle: Water ran out before the project could finish.
water.suggestion: Invest in water efficiency and recycling early to protect the water supply.
